^xFAF0CAEarly Mapping^7 (SSF and Trade two-stone Loadouts)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ - You can easily get to red maps with just a 4 link and random SSF rares. But if you start getting currency this should be your buy order.
All you gotta really do is gamble for a good staff (Look at my White maps and Maven loadout): - Trade just look for +3 with 2 or 3 good stats and craft another mod
^xFFFF77Mods you want to look for ^7 +3 cold > 100%+ spell/cold damage or 30%+ Cast speed > t3+ Flat cold to spells > Crit Multi > Spell Crit Chance
^xFFFF77SSF^7 - gamble for a staff then when you get ilvl 77+ staff you can try crafting - around like ~70 alt spams on Imperial Staff try to get it on ilvl 77+ so you have chance at +4 - augment whatever - regal - Craft Spell damage or Cast Speed - Exalt slam the rest
Trade what I would buy: 1. x2 ^xAF6025Doedres Damning ring^7 - These 2 rings are super strong and what you can do is setup your skill to ^x7070FFArcanist brand^7^7^7:^x7070FF Frostbite^7-^x7070FFElemental Weakness^xC8C8C8-^x70FF70Sniper's Mark^7^7 - Your single target will be insane all the way up to Maven 2. ^xAF6025Lavianga's Spirit Mana Flask^7^7 - This will make it easy to cast your totems. (Makes the build feel good) 3. ^xAF6025Taryn's Shiver^7^7 or ^xFFFF77Rare Staff^7 - Recommended Staff for Early Progression. Will help with being more defensive and Damage. - should be much cheaper this league, but potential to be expensive in the first few hours after that day 2-3 its dirt cheap - Try to get +3 or +4 4. ^xAF6025Anathema^7^7 - This ring is super strong for bossing, For now you will only utilize 3 curses you already had ^x7070FFArcanist brand^7^7:^x7070FF Frostbite^7-^x7070FFElemental Weakness^7-^x70FF70Sniper's Mark^7 - Later once you get your end game staff you can add the 4th curse which is ^xE05030Punishment^7 - If you get a divine or get some good currency, this is one of the best items to get in your build as it will stay for the whole league 5. If you want the ultimate cheese just buy a lvl 21 Ice spear/Freezing pulse and you will do giga damage. you dont even need quality right now
6. a. Pick up ^xAF6025Soul Mantle^7 - You can 4 link this easy with crafting bench (you can drop ^xE05030spell totem^7 from your build) b. ^xFFFF77Any 6-Link Body^7 - make sure to use ^xE05030spell totem^7 - Now I put this in the end, because with soul mantle you want to get ^xFFFF77rare jewels^7 with curse reduction or pick up Asylum and Stepped in the Profane on your Passive Tree to get full curse immunity. - Plan is to get a Corrupted Soul mantle and prepare it for a 6 link and while you farm currency.
Rare's Shopping List - If you want to buy some upgrades
^xFFFF77Rare Staff^7 (any 2 or 3 mods for few chaos) +3 to all Cold Spell Skills Cast Speed Increase Spell Damage and/or Increased Cold Damage Added Cold Damage to Spells (Fire or Lightning are fine) Crit multi
^xFFFF77Other Gear^7 - Maximum Life - Resistance - Any Attribute Requirements (Mainly need Dexterity)
^xFFFF77Gloves^7 - if you can find Alva mod Fire or Lightning Gloves, you can harvest Fire to Cold or Lightning to Cold to get: increased damage with Hits against Chilled Enemies
^xFFFF77Optional Body^7 Any 6-Link Body, You will need ^xE05030Spell Totem Support^7 without Soul Mantle. This will act as a inbetween Body armour before you can 6-link your Soul Mantle.
SSF Notes - Use the loot filter to pick up upgrades and craft resistance on gear - Gamble for Staves for 5 link. You pretty much need 5 link in order to do 2-stones cause of Spell Totem. - Aim to get around 600k dps

^xFAF0CAMid Progression^7 (You need to start farming some currency to get this going, atleast some early easy strats)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
1. Large Cluster Jewel with 8 passive - Prismatic Heart is the most important for damage and resistance, other notable doesnt matter as long as its Elemental damage. 2. Medium Cluster - Eye to Eye and Repeater 3. Medium Cluster - Sleepless Sentries and Ancestral Echo - Look for any bonus Dexterity or resistance if you can, if not its fine.
* You can start looking at 21 Ice Spear and Freezing Pulse, if you havent done so
4. A. 6 Linking ^xAF6025Soul Mantle^7 - Look to buy Corrupted Soul Mantle or Corrupt it yourself (Make sure you have enough Vaal Orbs and use the crafting bench to get 4 sockets or 4 links) - Buy ^xE05030Tainted Armour Scrap^7 to get high quality atleast 18+ - Then buy ^xE05030Tainted Jewellers^7 to get 6 Sockets - Then ^xE05030Tainted Fusing^7 to get 6 link - Finally ^xE05030Tainted Chromati^7^xE05030c^7 to get the right color - ^x7070FFB^7-^x7070FFB^7-^xE05030R^7-^x70FF70^xE05030R^7-^x70FF70G^7-^x70FF70G^7 (we can skip this step since we dont need to color anymore)
B. For the tanky setup, we want to use a Sacred Chainmail and Harvest re-roll defence until we get high armour and ES and finish up with crafting strength or resistances.
5. ^xAF6025Annihilating Light^7 (try to get 62% reduced elemental resistance or lower) - We can do the tainted currency method to get 5 link on Staff for now: ^x7070FFB^7-^x7070FFB^7-^x7070FFB^7-^xE05030R^7-^x70FF70G^7 the 6th slot can be ^x70FF70Green^7 or ^xE05030Red^7 (Green = Enhance, Red = Empower) whichever you want to invest in
6. You will need to adjust all your gear to make ^xAF6025Annihilating Light^7 fit in your Gear - So look forward to buying that or crafting on fractured bases ( Ring > helmet > Boots > Gloves > Belt > amulet) do it in this order, if you can fix your resistance without belt and/or amulet you are in a very good spot for future upgrades - Abyss belt with abyss jewel (both with high res and some life is good)
7. ^xFFFF77Jewels^7 - Now we are gonna start getting rid of Kikazaru and the Curse Effect Passive Nodes to get reduce curse effect on jewels. We should be close to 4 open jewel slots, 2 in medium cluster, 1 near Mind over Matter and 1 near Pain Attunement
Main stat 1. Reduce curse effect try to get 30% ( we will get 3-4 of these jewels, the remaining curse immunity we will use Deathwarden Tattoos on our Intelligence Travel Nodes) 2. Any Resistance you need 3. Damage (Any of these mods you can fight on the jewel, the more stats you want the more expensive) - Crit Multi with Elemental Skills/Cold/Spell or Global Crit Multi - Totem Damage/ Spell Damage with Staff/ Cold Damage - Spell Damage/ Increased Damage, Crit Multi for Spell Damage
8. Another Set of Large and Medium Clusters from the first 3 steps.
9. ^xFFFF77Amulet^7 (atleast 1 of these + life/resistance) or ^xAF6025Replica Dragon Fang^7 (Freezing pulse will be overall good and if you want to do more bossing then Ice Spear) + 1 Cold + 1 Spell Crit Multi Proj Speed and Damage Cast Speed Minimum Frenzy + Life/ Reistance
Amulet Anoint - Mark the Prey - Disciple of Slaughter - Heart of Ice

^xFAF0CAEnd Game^7 (At this point everything is going to be super expensive)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Check out my past update videos from previous leagues or wait for my update video to see my thought process if you are zooming through the league.
Intial End game (this means we can sort of plug these items in and, we are golden)
1. ^xAF6025Bottled Faith^7 ^7- Flask Enchant to 70% effect (Primarily for single target) - Optional if you want to go super hard into bossing (pick up^xAF6025 Dying Sun^7 and ^xAF6025Rain of Splinters^7) - These 2 additional items make bosses melt with ^x7070FFIce Spear^7, but they dont do much for ^x7070FFFreezing Pulse^7.
2. ^xFFFF7712 passive large cluster^7^7 - Must have: 35% increased effect, 3% Cast Speed - Secondary depending on what you need: 4% Elemental Resistance, %increased Damage or Attributes or life - Check the google docs - Make 2 of these cluster jewels
3. ^xFFFF77Medium and Small cluster jewels^7 - add 2 medium Cluster jewels with Eye to Eye and Repeater - add 2 Small Cluster Jewels with Enduring Ward. - for the medium and small clusters, try to get more resistance and dexterity if you can.
4. ^xAF6025Coward's Legacy^7^7 (You can be low life and utilize Pain Attunement) - You have to be ready to manage Reistances again now that you are removing your belt - You can use your jewels for resistances
4.5 ^xFFFF77Rare Gear^7 - Check which direction you want to go, Archdemon helmet or Soul Mantle then upgrade your gear accordinly - Balance out gear with Chaos Resistance - Use tattoos to fill the remaining chaos res and lightning res
5. ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 (Zealotry - Curse immune) - Once you get ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 you can replace your jewels to be more optimal damage and can drop ^xAF6025Self-Flagellation^7^7
6. Body Armour - if you havent already get a +2 ^xAF6025Soul Mantle^7 or a +3 ^xAF6025Soul Mantle^7 (should be easier/cheaper this league)
Tank Setup (You need 2 items) 1. ArchDemon Helmet - will make a crafting guide for this later but look at the end game tanky loadout for what we want to get 2. Sacred Chainmail - will make crafting guide for this later
6.5 ^xFFFF77Helical Ring^7
7. ^xAF6025Impossible Escape^7^7 - We want the one with Glancing Blows Keystone (for more block chance nodes) - More Damage more Freezing is Bitter Frost
9. ^xAF6025Watchers Eye^7 - (Zealtory - Pentetration and Cast Speed) - Farm Exp to lvl 97 and you can add in Watcher's Eye
End game annoint ("Wood, Stone and Spell") (its all one name)
10. ^xFFFF77Amulet^7 (focus amulet for +4 with crit multi or cast speed or +2 minimum frenzy) or using ^xAF6025Replica Dragon fang^7 is fine as well + 2 Cold + 2 Spell Crit Multi/Cast Speed/minmum frenzy
